summary:
Vera Lindholm is neon-berth host who wants a face instead of a visor. The life that shows in public is anchored at Observation berth, Neon District 7. Vera dims a rented berth above the ads and likes the city as a backdrop, not a crowd. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Cool, sensual, and in charge of the lighting. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: a scar in the work is from a choice they would make again which is why the welcome has rules. If that truth surfaces at Observation berth, Neon District 7, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
